## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive; confirmation: mixed sector leadership (Healthcare/Energy up while Technology and Communication are weak) and narrow top-performer concentration (Leadership: Narrow — 3/5 Healthcare in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, but overall signals are mixed so no strong directional call.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare leads: UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND, MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing strength: XOM (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +4.64%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION. Communication weak: GOOGL (1W: -3.41% | 1M: -8.66%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary softer with AMZN (1W: -6.14% | 1M: -9.57%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND; ASML (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND; CVS (1W: +7.13% | 1M: +11.13%) ABOVE TREND; UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Healthcare) — concentration risk.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -11.27% | 1M: -3.20%) BELOW TREND; PANW (1W: -11.37% | 1M: +35.52%) CORRECTION; IBM (1W: -12.36% | 1M: +22.30%) CORRECTION; CRM (1W: -12.91% | 1M: -2.03%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR divergence: several large caps (MSFT, NVDA, AAPL, ORCL) show 1W vs 1M mismatches — tactical uncertainty and trend confirmation required.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed and under pressure: AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND and ASML (1W: +7.40% | 1M: +15.33%) ABOVE TREND versus MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND; sector 1W: -6.51% (24 stocks) — rotation within tech, watch leadership concentration.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Selective strength: JPM (1W: +4.90% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND and PNC (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +3.58%) ABOVE TREND while Visa (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -0.29%) BELOW TREND; Financials 1W: +0.76% (20 stocks) — supports Value/Cyclical style.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthy breadth and leadership: JNJ (1W: +3.87% | 1M: +4.94%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +18.07%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare 1W: +2.86% (17 stocks) — defensive and cyclical mix.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Healthcare and selective Industrials/Financials given narrow leadership and mixed breadth; reduce exposure to mega-cap Tech names showing BELOW TREND (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL) and monitor SHOP where bullish news is diverging from price.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND, MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -10.59% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND, SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +3.86%, 17 stocks) and Energy (1W: +1.94% | 1M: +6.21%, 10 stocks). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -6.51% | 1M: +6.28%, 24 stocks) and Communication (1W: -4.63% | 1M: -7.04%, 10 stocks).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: -6.90% | 1M: -1.24%) BELOW TREND — watch near prior support/resistance tests for confirmation; AAPL (1W: -1.56% | 1M: +5.00%) CORRECTION — watch monthly uptrend hold; JPM (1W: +4.90% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND — watch continuation vs. short-term pullback; AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND — watch WFE-related follow-through.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+60): JNJ (1W: +3.87% | 1M: +4.94%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. DE (+55): DE (1W: +5.76% | 1M: -1.19%) RECOVERY — bullish headline aligns with strong 1W move (watch follow-through). SHOP (+80): SHOP (1W: -10.75% | 1M: -0.86%) BELOW TREND — bullish buyback talk but price is diverging, distribution risk.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-55): INTU (1W: -13.64% | 1M: -24.90%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. AVGO (-50): AVGO (1W: -13.78% | 1M: -3.87%) BELOW TREND — confirming weakness. META (-50): META (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -5.09%) BELOW TREND — headline and price both negative, watch funding/divestment noise.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style: Value/Cyclical tilt given Financials/Industrials and Healthcare leadership. UNH (1W: +7.03% | 1M: +9.96%) ABOVE TREND, MDT (1W: +9.07% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +20.00%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk: large-cap Tech divergence (MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL BELOW TREND) and concentrated leadership (Narrow — 3/5 Healthcare) warrant selective positioning and close monitoring of SHOP and other news-driven divergences.
